data.title: 雪之下雪乃 · 足浴时分
data.description: 【雪之下雪乃 · 足浴时分】月色清幽的庭院木廊下，雪乃坐在廊沿将黑丝褪至纤细的脚踝处，一双雪白小巧的玉足浸入温热的足汤中。水珠打湿了她的脚背，她红着脸将脸偏向一侧——「脚底……好热。为什么你总喜欢盯着别人的脚看？真是改不掉的恶趣味……」
data.lighting: moonlight along the veranda with a warm light beside the footbath
data.camera: full body, seated pose and both feet in the footbath visible
data.promptProse: Adult Yukino sits on the wooden veranda with both feet immersed in the warm footbath and her lowered stockings gathered at her ankles. She turns her flushed face aside beneath the moonlight and the small warm lamp.
